messages:
cam: Quick heads-up  the /v1/generate API reference shows the `stop` parameter as a single string in all examples, e.g. `stop: "\n"`, but the service now normalizes `stop` to an array of strings. This broke a few simple CLI integrations that passed a string and marshalled it differently in some SDKs.

cam: Docs example currently:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-clarity-1",
  "prompt": "Write a haiku",
  "stop": "\n"
}
```

cam: Runtime-accepted shape (what we see in traces):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-clarity-1",
  "prompt": "Write a haiku",
  "stop": ["\n"]
}
```

nina: Ah yeah, we migrated to array form to support multi-sequence stop lists but failed to update a few reference snippets. SDKs generally accept either but the raw HTTP samples in docs caused confusion. Thanks for spotting.

cam: I opened a tiny PR to update curl/Python/Node samples and add a migration note: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12899. I also included a defensive example for Python/Node showing how to accept both forms.

alex: Nice. For the Python snippet prefer the SDK helper, but add a small helper for teams using raw HTTP:```python
# defensive: accept string or list for `stop`
stop_value = user_supplied_stop
if isinstance(stop_value, str):
    body = {"model":"redwood-clarity-1","prompt":prompt,"stop":[stop_value]}
else:
    body = {"model":"redwood-clarity-1","prompt":prompt,"stop":stop_value}
resp = requests.post(url, json=body)
```

nina: Can you also add a note in the API reference: "stop accepts string or array; server normalizes to array in requests" so copy-paste integrations are less likely to fail?

cam: Done in the PR description and added an inline callout on the page. I kept one legacy single-string example but commented it with a deprecation note for discoverability.

docs-bot: lint/docs-check failed: JSON codeblock in markdown must use triple-backticks with language tag (file: api/generate.md line 102).

cam: Fixing markdown codeblock tags now (adding json). Pushing update in 10m.

alex: Can we add a tiny docs spec test that ensures the example body for generate uses "stop": [ when a stop is present? That will catch reverts to old style.

nina: Good idea. Add that to docs/spec. Also ping #eng-runtime if any customer needs a short compatibility window on older proxies.

staging-bot: Deployed fix/generate-stop-array to staging at 1920123520 (sha: a1b2c3d). Preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/api/generate#params

cam: Preview looks good; examples render correctly. Closing after the spec test merges. :white_check_mark:
